title: News dates put back in order
summary:
A spring-cleaning day for news dates, documentation links, and supporter credits.

Corrected the Special Bee request and API documentation news entries to March 28, 2025, and refreshed the README’s Latest News links. June 31 has been returned to the realm of fiction.

Special Bee request links now open the GitHub issue form rather than its template file. React Hooks links point to the README and playground, alongside a small README tidy-up.

Updated the website and README supporter lists, with Cloudflare, Scaleway, and Modal named in the README and those three plus LLMPlayground.net shown in its supporter image.
